scope: local consumer boundaries, not independent cross-owner acceptance

boundaries.contract: Owner installs finder and initializes audit, blocked set and exception tuple. Sequence reset setter clears candidate/carried/post-stop/direct caches but not the trend-leg-position cache. Main index delegates clamp=True; confirmation delegates chronology; First derives from times[int(first_idx)]. Cache reuse assumes run-consistent sorted position, geometry, arrays and callbacks.

OA20 calls OA16 before native fallback; confirmation_after applies to returned canonical geometry; separate native selection and E exception rules are not local OA16 rules. Candidate rejection in OA16 does not eliminate OA20 fallback.

order_candidates calls direct path first; optional allow_trend_leg_continue gates OA17 separately, and successful matches enter identity merge. Local geometry result does not itself prove final parent-stop ownership, stop or crossing.
